title: From Prompt to Presentation
subtitle: A modular AI workflow for turning raw inputs into meeting-ready decks

slides.title: Presentation work is a pipeline, not a single prompt
slides.key_message: Separating research, narrative, QA and rendering makes the workflow easier to control.
content: Inputs can come from topics, notes or documents
A deterministic renderer creates the PowerPoint
QA is isolated as its own review step
slides.visual: Horizontal pipeline: Input → Skills → QA → JSON → PPTX
slides.speaker_notes: Explain why a modular workflow is easier to debug and extend.

slides.title: Skills define behavior while workflows define order
slides.key_message: Reusable skills keep presentation quality rules independent from orchestration.
content: Research skill builds an evidence map
Presentation skill creates storyline and slides
QA skill detects structural and content problems
slides.visual: Four modular skill cards connected to an orchestration layer
slides.speaker_notes: Emphasize the separation between capability definitions and execution flow.

slides.title: Structured JSON is the contract between AI and PowerPoint
slides.key_message: The model does not directly manipulate slides; it produces validated structured data.
content: Renderer can be replaced without changing prompts
Model can be replaced without changing PPTX code
slides.visual: JSON object in the center with AI on the left and PPTX on the right
slides.speaker_notes: Describe the JSON schema as an interface contract.

slides.title: The demo runs without a paid AI API
slides.key_message: A deterministic demo proves the renderer independently of any model provider.
content: Local Ollama mode can be enabled separately
slides.visual: Terminal command flowing into a generated PowerPoint file
slides.speaker_notes: The demo is intentionally API-free so the repository remains easy to test.

slides.title: Local AI keeps the architecture provider-independent
slides.key_message: Ollama can generate the presentation JSON locally while the rest of the pipeline stays unchanged.
content: Local model receives the presentation skill
The same renderer produces the final deck
slides.speaker_notes: Mention that model quality varies and production systems should add retries and stronger validation.

slides.title: The next extension is richer document ingestion
slides.key_message: The architecture already defines where PDF, DOCX and URL adapters plug into the pipeline.
slides.visual: Three input adapters converging into one normalized evidence object
slides.speaker_notes: Be explicit that these adapters are roadmap items rather than completed v1 features.
